Variants.Content: Yronwood City is located in the northeast of Dorne, at the southern foot of the Crimson Mountains, close to the mountain pass from the Bone Road to the Stormlands. It is the ancient territory of the Yronwood family. It belongs to Dorne, but it has long had a military strength similar to that of the border lords; controlling it, one can monitor the communication between the northern mountain passes and the interior of Dorne.

Entry Yronwood Local families also rely on wells, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and travel to avoid the hot sun; if any road, well, or dock fails, the cost falls first on them.
Entry Yronwood They also recognize Dornish accents, laws and credentials; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar or horse's hoof.

Entry Yronwood If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Yronwood A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Yronwood They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
